title: Traditional Portuguese Yeast Bread
description: A crispy crust and fluffy interior make this Portuguese yeast bread perfect for sandwiches or toast.
instructions: Combine yautia, yeast, and warm water in a large mixing bowl.
Let the mixture sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
Add flour and salt to the bowl, mixing until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and shape it into a round loaf.
Place the loaf on a baking sheet and bake for 35-40 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let the bread cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes before slicing.
